definitions.explanation: Hasty, ill-considered thinking or action; making a decision without enough deliberation. A formal, somewhat literary word.

examples.japanese: {短慮|たんりょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{慎|つつし}む→慎む：09158_tsutsushimu⟧。
{短慮|たんりょ}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧。
⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{短慮|たんりょ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}めてしまった。
examples.english: Out of a moment's rashness, he quit his important job.

notes:
Combines ⟦{短|たん}→短〜：03959_tan⟧ (short) + {慮|りょ} (thought, consideration); literally 'short thinking.' A formal, somewhat literary word for acting without enough forethought.

USAGE:
- As a noun: {短慮|たんりょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{慎|つつし}む→慎む：09158_tsutsushimu⟧ (to refrain from rashness)
- As a na-adjective: {短慮|たんりょ}な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧ (a rash judgment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{軽率|けいそつ}→軽率：06866_keisotsu⟧: careless; hasty — more common, emphasizes carelessness
- {浅慮|せんりょ}: shallow thinking — close synonym, also formal
